source: Sustainable Web Design Model v4 (sustainablewebdesign.org/estimating-digital-emissions), coefficient values as published in the reference implementation co2.js v0.19.0 (thegreenwebfoundation.org)

notes.globalGridIntensity: Global average grid intensity (Ember yearly electricity data). Used for all segments unless overridden.
notes.greenHosting: A green-hosting factor of 1 removes the data-center operational-electricity emissions only; embodied emissions always remain.
notes.embodiedGridIntensity: Embodied emissions always use the global grid intensity per the published model, regardless of segment overrides.
